VOL. CLXI No. 46
Part A BRIDGETOWN, BARBADOS, 16TH APRIL, 2026
Content
S.I. 2026 No. 55: Declaration of Approved Small Business
(Peake Property (Barbados) Ltd.) Order, 2026.
16th April, 2026
S.I. 2026 No. 55
Small Business Development Act
CAP. 318C
DECLARATION OF APPROVED SMALL BUSINESS
(PEAKE PROPERTY (BARBADOS) LTD.) ORDER, 2026
The Minister, in exercise of the powers conferred on him by section 4 of the
Small Business Development Act, makes the following Order:
1. This Order may be cited as the Declaration of Approved Small
Business (Peake Property (Barbados) Ltd.) Order, 2026.
2. For the purposes of the Small Business Development Act, Cap. 318C,
Peake Property (Barbados) Ltd., a company incorporated under the Companies
Act, Cap. 308 as Company No. 50164, the registered office of which is located
at Unit 32 Clermont Green, in the parish of Saint Michael, is declared to be an
approved small business.
3. Peake Property (Barbados) Ltd., is granted the following incentives
in respect of its business:
(a) exemption from withholding tax on dividends and interest earned on
any investment in an approved small business or in any fund approved
for investment in small businesses;
(b) exemption from the payment of stamp duty under the Stamp Duty
Act, Cap. 91 on all documents related to the business, where the
registration of those documents is required by law; and
(c) a deduction of corporation tax of an amount equal to 20 per cent of the
actual expenditure incurred in respect of the use of technology, market

research and any other activity that is, in the opinion of the Revenue
Commissioner, directly related to the development of the business.
Made by the Minister this 1st day of April, 2026.
KERRIE SYMMONDS
Minister responsible for Business Development
